claims: SRP Batcher reduces CPU render-state setup for materials sharing a shader variant.
Compatible custom shaders place engine properties in UnityPerDraw and material properties in UnityPerMaterial.
MaterialPropertyBlock makes a renderer incompatible with SRP Batcher; GPU instancing can be preferable for many identical meshes and must be profiled.
Unity 2022.3 provides Built-in, URP, HDRP and custom SRP choices with different feature and performance characteristics.
Dynamic resolution support and platform constraints are version and backend dependent; it requires target-platform validation.
URP uses the Volume framework for global and local camera-dependent overrides, including post-processing settings.
Volume contributions depend on camera position and active Volume components; style templates must distinguish global defaults from local scene overrides.
URP integrates post-processing through its Volume framework and does not use the Post Processing Stack v2 package.
Post-processing effects and low-end constraints require explicit target-platform and readability validation.
URP Renderer Features are configured as children of a Renderer asset; they are a bounded composition point for passes such as SSAO, screen-space shadows and render objects.
Renderer Feature selection belongs to the ES quality/scene budget rather than arbitrary business-script mutation.
Unity 6 URP provides a built-in Decal Shader Graph path and supports custom decal shaders for project-specific presentation.
Decal adoption remains a Unity 6 forward-compatibility candidate and requires Renderer Feature and target-scene validation.

scope: Bounded calibration facts only; not Runtime, Frame Debugger, Profiler, Player or release evidence.
